# authwise_endpoints (Data Source)

A service kit calls out to: its transport and address, how kit verifies it (`tls`), how kit authenticates to it (`auth`), and the per-call deadline (`timeout`). This data source lists every one under a parent.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default.

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Every endpoint under the parent, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String)
- `auth` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `endpoint_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `endpoint_type` (String)
- `insecure` (Boolean)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `name` (String) Full resource name.
- `timeout` (String)
- `tls` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--tls))

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.tls`

Read-Only:

- `ca_pem` (String)
- `client_certificate` (String)
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean)
- `server_name` (String)
